card.name: Dosing and citation numbers, mixed
card.fires_on: Partway through "dosing" in "every 3-week dosing regimen", and on digits or punctuation inside numbers in dose amounts and journal citations (volume, issue, page ranges).

modes.label: Dosing regimen wording
modes.description: The start of the word dosing right after an interval such as every 3-week.
modes.example: at an every 3-week<< dos>>ing regimen at their next scheduled dose on

modes.label: Digits in dose amounts
modes.description: A digit or space inside a dose number, before units such as mg or g.
modes.example: adults with moderate to severe PsO is 3<<0>>0 mg by subcutaneous injection at

modes.label: Journal citation punctuation
modes.description: Colons, periods, brackets or spaces inside volume, issue and page details in reference lists.

card.writes: It suppresses words about frequency (frequent, frequency, twice), so it makes frequency wording less likely next.
card.plain: It fires inside dosing-interval phrases, dose numbers and reference citations, where a word about how often is unlikely to come next.
